headline: Approved revised financial policy 2.4 and designated voting representatives for VSBIT and VSBA annual meetings.
summary: The meeting included student presentations from QSA and SOAR, a financial review, a cell phone policy update, and discussion of the Ends Policy and the Act 170 merger committee. Members approved revised Executive Limitation 2.4 and designated voting representatives for the VSBIT and VSBA annual meetings. The Ends Policy action was moved to the next meeting.
decisions: Concluded the superintendent should write the 2.3 Monitoring Report.
Continued the Ends Policy update (third reading) to the next meeting.
Approved the revisions to Executive Limitation 2.4 Financial Condition and Activities, 'All in favor.'
Approved designating Seamus Abshere to vote at the VSBIT Annual Meeting, 'All in favor.'
Approved designating Elissa Galvez to vote at the VSBA Annual Meeting, 'All in favor.'
Approved the consent agenda after no objections were heard.

decision_evidence.quote: the conclusion was made that the superintendent should write the 2.3 Monitoring Report.
Seamus Abshere proposed, due to missing a few Board members, that the Board push the actual action on the Ends Policy to the next School Board meeting.

Seamus Abshere motioned to approve the revisions to Executive Limitation 2.4 Financial Condition and Activities using the text provided in the Board materials. Emilee Hoffman moved. Dan Boyer seconded. No discussion. All in favor. Motion passed.
Emilee Hoffman moved to designate Seamus Abshere to vote, as their Board member, at the annual meeting. Dan Boyer seconded. No discussion. All in favor. Motion passed.

Thomas Chittenden motioned that Elissa Galvez be designated as the Board member to vote at the VSBA Annual Meeting. Emilee Hoffman seconded the motion, contingent on the fact that Elissa Galvez would want to be designated. No discussion. All in favor. Motion passed.
Seamus Abshere asked if there were any objections to the consent agenda. Hearing no objections, the agenda passed by consent.
